description: This is a shell script (bash) for the VibeTunnel logging utility, designed to simplify access to macOS's unified logging system for the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem. It provides commands for viewing, filtering, streaming, and exporting logs related to the OpenClaw project, with various options for filtering by category, level, time range, and search terms. The script also includes user guidance and category listing functionalities.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Handles cases where sudo privileges are required and not available

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays help and usage information for the script

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Fetches and lists recent log categories for the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user input for safe inclusion in log predicates
